name: daily_brief_ask_titles_v1
description: Brief Needs-you (aegis-zmk): open seeds titled "ASK Stiwi", found from the rdfs:label index. Item, title and status only; measured ~1-3s on 45b2333e.
scope: every open seed whose title starts with ASK Stiwi; overflow is UNKNOWN
template: PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?item ?title ?status WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { ?item rdfs:label ?title . FILTER(STRSTARTS(?title, "ASK Stiwi")) ?item seeds:status ?status . FILTER(?status != "closed" && ?status != "tombstone") } } LIMIT 300
